_comment: DEMO SHELL DATA. Every entry below is an ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE with a SAMPLE-* code, not a real Scandit error. Real content (literal console messages + verified fixes) will be supplied from the support/licensing ticket data and replace these. The `match` array holds the invariant substrings used for paste-to-filter matching.

entries.title: License key placeholder was never replaced
entries.message: A valid license key is required. The provided key looks like the documentation placeholder.
match: enter your scandit license key here
a valid license key is required
entries.cause: The code still contains the docs placeholder `-- ENTER YOUR SCANDIT LICENSE KEY HERE --` instead of a real key.
entries.fix: Paste your real key into the license field at the top of the get-started page (or set it directly in the DataCaptureContext call). Get a free key from the trial dashboard if you don't have one.

entries.title: License key is invalid or malformed
entries.message: License validation failed: the provided key could not be parsed.
entries.cause: The key string is truncated, has extra whitespace/line breaks, or was copied only partially.
entries.fix: Re-copy the entire key from the dashboard as a single line with no wrapping, and make sure no characters were dropped when pasting.

entries.title: License has expired
entries.cause: The trial or subscription tied to this key has ended.
entries.fix: Generate a new key or extend your trial in the dashboard, then replace the key in your app.

entries.title: License is not valid for this application
entries.message: The license key is not valid for this application's bundle identifier.
entries.cause: The key was issued for a different bundle ID / package name than the app it is running in.
entries.fix: Create a key for the current bundle identifier (or add this bundle ID to the existing key's allowed apps in the dashboard).

entries.title: Enabled feature is not included in the license
entries.message: The license does not include the enabled functionality.
entries.cause: The code enables a mode (for example a specific scanning capability) that this key is not entitled to.
entries.fix: Either disable the unlicensed mode, or request a key that includes the feature you need.

entries.title: Camera permission was denied
entries.message: Camera access denied. The scanner cannot start without camera permission.
entries.cause: The app did not request, or the user declined, camera permission — so the preview never opens.
entries.fix: Add the camera usage description to your app configuration and request permission before starting the scanner. On device, re-enable camera access for the app in system settings.
